correctness.rationale: Luecke--Poveda Theorem 1.3 yields from an I2-embedding a transitive set-sized M satisfying ZFC plus a proper class of exacting cardinals. Internally in M, exacting cardinals are unbounded. Osinski Corollary 5.9 is a ZFC equivalence between that assertion and the universal rank-type compactness scheme. Applying the equivalence inside M proves the claim without any upward-absoluteness assumption.

value.rationale: The result gives a transitive-model relative-consistency upper bound from I2 for a natural universal compactness scheme quantified over every logic. Osinski explicitly motivates consistency strength of compactness principles, while Luecke--Poveda newly provide the proper-class-exacting model needed to realize this particular scheme. The bridge therefore supplies structural consistency information not stated by either source alone.
